facts.summary: ADG20 lost >300-fold neutralizing activity against Omicron in vitro; South Africa recruitment paused · Phase 2/3 · ADG20 in COVID-19 · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The in vitro data generated through both authentic and pseudovirus testing of the Omicron variant show a greater than 300-fold reduction in neutralizing activity of ADG20 against Omicron.
evidence.safety: Based on the in vitro findings related to Omicron, Adagio plans to pause patient recruitment in its Phase 2/3 COVID-19 treatment trial at clinical sites in South Africa
evidence.program_discontinued: Adagio is evaluating next steps for its ADG20 program.
